note: FFX2-G06 queue level: add = queue add at the tail (0x62d300) from the note's byte-image oracle; cancelOne = 0x62d120 with delta -1; cancel = the family (0x62c500 all, 0x62c770 handle, 0x62c6a0 command; p3 = 1 includes running records); gate = the start gate (0x6314c0), the emulator's own logged answers. A record is [handle, state, kind, protect, command, got, needed, id0, id1, gilNeeded, gilReserved, second, aborted]; w and post are as in item_ledger.json.
